verdict.rationale: The skill installer offers CLI commands (`npx skills add/update`, `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`) that could in principle be scripted by an agent, but the docs explicitly describe an interactive setup step that 'asks you which issue tracker you want to use (GitHub, Linear, or local files)', meaning the flow is not fully promptless. No evidence of a documented non-interactive/headless flag or CI-mode install exists in the pack. missing for 10: explicit non-interactive/headless install flag, documentation confirming the tracker-choice prompt can be bypassed, and any first-party or community confirmation of an agent completing install end-to-end without human input.
